source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Bus Topology' (PDF 10): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Bus topology mein tamam devices ek hi main cable se jure hote hain. Data isi cable ke saath chal kar har device tak pohanchta hai. Yeh simple (saada) aur sasti hai. Main cable fail (kharab) ho jaye to poora network ruk sakta hai (jaise Figure 1.8 mein). Yeh chhote networks ke liye suitable (munasib) hai. Bare networks ke liye bus topology achhi nahi.

blocks.alt: Bus topology: chhe devices (do desktop computers, laptop, do servers aur printer) har aik chhoti cable se aik lambi main cable se jura hai; main cable ke dono siron par terminator hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.8: Bus topology (kitab ki Figure 1.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 1.8 mein main cable beech se tooti hui chhapi hai, aur chhe mein se do devices sirf devices ke darmiyan ek patli taar par latke dikhaye gaye hain. Bus topology mein har device ek hi lagataar main cable se jura hota hai, is liye oopar ek poori main cable banayi gayi hai. Dono siron par terminator hai jo signal ko cable ke sire se wapas takrane se rokta hai.

blocks.prompt: Bus topology mein main cable kat jaye to kya hoga?
blocks.explanation: Poora network ruk sakta hai, kyun ke saare devices isi ek cable se jure hain.

items: Bus: ek main cable, saada aur sasti; main cable kharab to poora network band; chhote networks ke liye.
